before: An undo or redo while the collaboration session could not write was refused with "nothing to undo" or "nothing to redo", and the keyboard lane reported nothing.
after: The refusal names the session's reason, such as collaboration-session-not-ready, through exec and the keyboard lane. Sessions report it through the new optional EditorCollaborationSession.writeRefusal member.
reason: Only the local refusal reason changes. writeRefusal reads readiness and reports nothing. No shared state, update, room rule, or stored representation changes.
